text: Hello and welcome to the live commentary of the Premier League clash between Sheffield United and Aston Villa at Bramall Lane.
The Blades are winless in their last six Premier League games, but did earn a point on the road in the reverse fixture at Villa Park.
Chris Wilder's men were minutes away from a vital win, only to concede at the death to Nicolo Zaniolo's strike.
They did earn a point in their last home match against West Ham as Ollie McBurnie fired in a stoppage-time penalty.
But, with games running out to save themselves, United could do with three points today.
Aston Villa's Premier League title ambitions have taken a huge hit in recent weeks.
Unai Emery's side were well in contention in December, but since the draw with the Blades, Villa have won only one of their last four.
Defeats to Manchester United and Newcastle have knocked them off the pace of the leader and out of the top four, although they can leapfrog Tottenham back into the Champions League places with a win.
Wilder has made five changes to his side that were beaten 3-2 by Crystal Palace during the week.
Deadline day signing Holgate makes his debut in the back three, while Foderingham replaces the injured Ivo Grbic.
Brooks, Norrington-Davies and Osula all come into the fold.
Hamer and Robinson drop to the bench and McBurnie and Anis Ben Slimane miss out.
Villa have made two changes from their loss to Newcastle last time out.
Diaby makes way in the final third for Bailey, while Carlos slots into the backline to replace Cash.
Konsa will kick out to full-back, while Carlos partners Lenglet in the middle.
Cash and Diaby are both options off the bench.
Although Sheffield United have struggled this season, there is cause for optimism ahead of kick-off.
The Blades have won their last three meetings against Villa at Bramall Lane.
We're under way at Bramall Lane.
There's almost a chance for Osula to latch onto a deflection in the Villa box, but Martinez is alert to gather ahead of the forward.
Brereton Diaz and Norrington-Davies combine down the left flank, allowing the latter to break into the box.
Norrington-Davies goes for the cutback, but sees his cross cleared by Carlos.
Vinicius brings down Watkins in the Sheffield United half.
Villa have the chance to threaten from the resulting set-piece.
OVER! Bailey rolls the ball to McGinn to power an effort at goal on his left foot, only to launch his attempt well over the bar.
Luiz attempts an ambitious strike from 35 yards, but his effort trickles into the hands of Foderingham.
The Blades keeper has made five errors leading to goals in the Premier League this season, but he was making no mistake with that one.
Luiz floats a ball over the top searching for Watkins behind the Blades defence.
The ball takes a kind bounce towards Foderingham, allowing the keeper to gather.
SAVE! Brereton Diaz latches onto Trusty's ball over the top and he surges into the inside-left channel.
He goes for goal with a low strike that Martinez fumbles, but gathers at the second attempt.
WIDE! Watkins turns in the final third and offloads to Bailey on the edge of the box.
The winger turns inside and shoots on his left foot, but places his effort just past the left post.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!! MCGINN SCORES ON THE REBOUND!!!!!! 1-0 VILLA!! The visitors take the lead as the Scot pounces after Watkins' effort hits the post.
Watkins latches onto a long ball over the top and lifts a strike over the onrushing Foderingham.
Ahmedhodzic makes a desperate lunge to clear it off the line, but fails to connect as it hits the post.
McGinn is first to react and places the ball into an empty net.
Villa find space down the right flank and threaten the Blades defence, but Bailey's cross is repelled to give the home side respite for now.

GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!! WATKINS BURIES HIS STRIKE!!!!!! 2-0 VILLA!!!! The forward makes another brilliant run behind the Blades defence and smashes his effort low and hard past Foderingham.
Luiz threads the needle with the outside of his boot following a failed Sheffield United attack to send Watkins on his way.
He takes his effort first time before Ahmedhodzic can act and finds the bottom-left corner.
The home side are in a world of trouble now.
Luiz releases Watkins with a perfect pass with the outside of his boot from the centre circle before the forward does the rest.
Only Gabriel Agbonlahor (40) has scored more Premier League away goals for Aston Villa than Watkins (23, level with Dwight Yorke)
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!! BAILEY SCORES A STUNNER!!!! 3-0 VILLA!!!!! The home side are caught cold on the counter again and Bailey produces a stunning finish into the top-left corner.
Watkins plays a simple pass to Bailey in acres of space in the Sheffield United half.
Bailey surges at Norrington-Davies before he cuts inside on his left foot and curls his effort beyond Foderingham's reach.
This could get messy for Wilder's men.
Watkins gathers a loose ball and spots Bailey in space.
The winger does the rest with an incisive finish.

This is just the third time in Premier League history Aston Villa have been 3-0 up in the opening 20 minutes of a Premier League game after August 2003 against Leicester and October 2022 against Brentford.
Moreno brings down Osula on the right flank, handing the Blades a free-kick in a useful position.
WIDE! Holgate rises to attack McAtee's dangerous delivery on his left foot, but glances his header wide of the left post.
He may have been offside anyway.
Panic stations again for the home side at the back.
Bailey feeds Konsa, who turns inside a challenge, but sees his effort blocked by Foderingham before McAtee clears behind.
There is an air of apathy around Bramall Lane.
Some fans have already headed for the exits.
It could be a long night for Wilder and his team.
OFF THE LINE! Tielemans latches onto a precise cross from Luiz after a clever corner routine.
He takes a touch and hammers his effort into the ground.
It beats Foderingham, but Vinicius is in the right place at the right time to head it off the line and over the bar.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!! TIELEMANS SCORES THIS TIME!!!!! 4-0 VILLA!!!! Villa are embarrassing Sheffield United now as Tielemans gathers the ball and hammers his strike in off the bar.
On this occasion, the corner is cleared into his path on the edge of the box.
The Belgian takes a touch and blasts his effort through a crowd of players before it rattles the underside of the bar and nestles in the back of the net.
OVER! Bailey turns the ball around the corner to Watkins, who goes for first-time lob over Foderingham.
However, he lifts his effort harmlessly over the bar.
Aston Villa are the first team to score four goals or more in the opening 30 minutes of a Premier League away game since Chelsea vs Bolton in October 2011.
There are a lot of empty seats in the home end at Bramall Lane.
It has been a harrowing half of football for all connected to the Blades.
Sheffield United have changed their shape to become more compact in the middle of the park.
It's far too late to alter the result, but they just need to stop the flow of goals.
Trusty has to act on the edge of the United box to prevent Bailey from latching onto yet another through ball.
The defender clears into touch.
Moreno goes for the give-and-go with McGinn, but Bogle does well to get his body between the Villa left-back and the ball to win a free-kick.
Bailey produces a sublime backheel to evade Norrington-Davies down the right flank and he sends a dangerous low ball across the face of goal that Ahmedhodzic does well to clear.
Bogle takes a swipe at Moreno's heels and goes into the book.
That was a tackle of a frustrated player.
There will be four minutes of added time.
It's all to easy for Villa on the ball.
The fans in the away end are bringing out the ole's.
Tielemans drives through the middle of the United midfield and tries to find Watkins with a neat pass, but the ball travels through to Foderingham.
HALF-TIME: SHEFFIELD UNITED 0-4 ASTON VILLA
Aston Villa put forward a dominant display in the first half to take a 4-0 lead into the break against Sheffield United.
John McGinn opened the scoring with a tap-in after Ollie Watkins struck the post, but Watkins soon got his goal with a precise finish.
The forward then turned provider for Leon Bailey to find the net with a stunner and Youri Tielemans continued the onslaught with a rocket off the underside of the bar.
Villa were sublime, while the Blades were all over the place at the back.
Chris Wilder's men were booed off and he faces a major challenge on his hands to prevent this defeat becoming even more humiliating for his team.
Although United were terrible, Villa were excellent in punishing the hosts on the counter.
Douglas Luiz and Watkins were outstanding with their distribution, while all three finishes outside of McGinn's were exceptional.
Villa only have a expected goals rating of 1.7, highlighting the quality we've seen in the final third.
In a tight battle for the top four, they'll be keen to boost their goal difference in the second half.
Wilder withdraws Osula at the break and replaces him with Hamer.
Brereton Diaz could go central for the hosts.
After a stellar first half, Emery takes the chance to withdrawn Luiz to replace him with Ramsey.
Villa don't need to take any risks.
We're back under way at Bramall Lane.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!! MORENO HAMMERS IN A FIFTH!!!!! 5-0 VILLA!!!!! Trusty fails to clear his lines and Watkins scoops a cross to the back post where Moreno blasts home a strike.
Trusty makes two mistakes as he fails to cut out Konsa's pass forward and then compounds his error by presenting possession straight to Watkins.
He floats a cross to the back stick where Moreno delivers a predatory finish on his left foot, striking the ball first time past Foderingham.
Watkins pounces on a mistake by Trusty in the right-inside channel.
He picks out Moreno with a pinpoint cross, who delivers the finish.
Osborn replaces Brooks in the Sheffield United midfield.
Brooks was overwhelmed by Villa's quality in the middle of the park.
Norrington-Davies has had a torrid time on his first Premier League start and is replaced by Robinson.
Bogle latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the Villa box and connects sweetly on the volley, but Martinez watches his effort sail wide of the left post.
Watkins is the first player to register double figures for both goals (11) and assists (10) in the Premier League this season.
What a season for the forward!
It's all Villa at the moment and the visitors look hungry to add to the scoreline.
They're looking to take advantage of a United side, whose confidence is rock bottom.
CLOSE! Ramsey draws a foul from Holgate and it gives the chance for Bailey to lift a cross to the back post.
Konsa attacks the delivery, but he just fails to connect amid Trusty's boot that edges it behind.
Konsa remains down after the fact as he collided with the post in his attempt the head the ball.
He requires treatment and may be withdrawn given the scoreline.
Konsa is going to have to make way as he applauds the Villa fans from the touchline.
Cash enters the game to replace the injured Konsa at right-back.
He has a point to prove after being left out of the starting line-up.
Bailey put on a clinic in the first half, scoring a stunner on his left foot.
Diaby replaces him on the Villa right.
There's no let up for the Blades defence.
Brereton Diaz almost finds space down the right flank, but the pressure arrives from Lenglet and Moreno to ensure the attack is halted.
Whereas the Blades have been passive in their pressing, Villa have been aggressive in their approach and have given the hosts no time on the ball.
Archer, who scored in the reverse fixture, enters the contest to replace Brereton Diaz.
The forward had a tough game as he was isolated in the final third.
For a team that have won only one of their last five in the Premier League, Villa have been outstanding.
They're going back into the top four in emphatic fashion.
Watkins drives into space down the left flank and sends a dangerous cutback into the middle that Robinson clears ahead of Diaby.
Every time Watkins gets the ball he's a threat.
Emery is taking his chance to ease the burden on his key men.
McGinn takes off the armband and is replaced Iroegbunam.
Davies makes his return from injury for the Blades as he replaces McAtee, who has endured a tough evening.
SAVE! Tielemans feeds Diaby in the right-inside channel and he skips past two challenges before cutting back on his left foot to fire at goal, but Foderingham beats away his attempt.
The Blades have a rare spell of possession, but Archer has to clear the ball into touch to prevent Osborn's throughball from going behind for a goal-kick.
Ramsey plays Tielemans into acres of space in the final third and he has two men in support, but goes himself and loses possession.
Diaby and Watkins are not impressed.
Archer has the chance to get a consolation goal, but Carlos is on hand to clear his low ball across the face of goal behind.
OFF THE LINE AND SAVED! Sheffield United threaten from the resulting corner as Robinson rises to meet Hamer's cross.
Watkins clear the ball off the line before the Blades regain possession.
Hamer sends another delivery into the middle that Robinson steers towards goal, but on this occasion Martinez makes a brilliant reaction stop.
That Sheffield United miss will be a concern for Emery.
Villa conceded two cheap goals against Newcastle in their defeat in midweek and were exposed there.
Villa's deadline-day signing Rogers replaces Tielemans for the closing stages.
Tielemans scored a stunner to mark a fine performance.
Villa have stepped off the gas in the last 10 minutes.
Their pressing has been excellent throughout the game, but they've just started to allow the Blades space in their half.
Osborn is played into space down the left flank and he has options in the middle.
He places a dangerous ball across the face of goal, but no red and white shirt is there to convert.
OVER! Rogers misses a chance to notch a debut goal.
Cash and Diaby combine down the right flank and latter sends a cutback into the middle.
Rogers drifts into space and meets the ball first time, only to clear the bar with his strike.
Archer surges into the Villa box, but he stumbles at the last second as he tries to get a shot away.
His delay allows Carlos to get across and block his eventual shot.
Hamer is the latest Blade to take on a strike from the angle on the left flank, but Martinez beats his effort away from danger.
Ahmedhodzic is brought down in the final third by Kamara and it hands the Blades a free-kick in a useful position.
There will be five minutes of added time.
VAR! DISALLOWED GOAL! Vinicius has the ball in the back of the net as he converts Robinson's cutback following a neat free-kick from Hamer.
But, the Blades' joy is short lived as VAR deems that Robinson is offside in the build-up.
That sums up the hosts' night.
The check by VAR took three minutes, so the Blades' agony will be prolonged here.
The Villa fans are making all the noise at Bramall Lane.
It has been a dominant performance from start to finish from the visitors.
Villa are knocking the ball around with ease.
It has been another cruel lesson for the Blades in the Premier League this season.
FULL-TIME: SHEFFIELD UNITED 0-5 ASTON VILLA
Aston Villa have stormed back into the top four of the Premier League with a 5-0 hammering of Sheffield United at Bramall Lane.
The Villans suffered their first home defeat in almost a year in midweek against Newcastle, but have issued the perfect response.
Unai Emery's men did the majority of the damage in the first half, scoring four goals in 30 minutes.
John McGinn broke the deadlock before Ollie Watkins produced a clinical finish for the second.
Leon Bailey and Youri Tielemans then added super strikes of their own.
After the break, Alex Moreno notched a fifth with a fine volley to cap the performance for the visitors.
VAR denied the Blades a consolation goal in stoppage time to chalk off Vinicius Souza's effort, which summed up a torrid day for Chris Wilder's men.
Sheffield United face a huge game against Luton on the road in their next outing, while Villa take on Chelsea in a fourth-round replay in the FA Cup at Villa Park on Wednesday.
